clean_description: Washington Black follows the journey of an eleven-year-old slave named George Washington Black, or Wash, on a Barbados sugar plantation. Chosen as a servant by his master's abolitionist brother, Christopher Wilde, Wash is introduced to a world of exploration and invention, including a flying machine. After a tragic event forces them to flee, Wash embarks on a global journey of self-discovery, grappling with themes of identity, freedom, and the complexities of human relationships.
